snippet.title: Prime Monster - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
We just released Prime Monster!

Step into a parliament of literal monsters in this card-based political roguelike.
Win votes, bend the rules, survive scandals and push through absurd laws to stay in power.

A chaotic democratic dystopia where anything goes… as long as you stay on top.

Available now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3214480/Prime_Monster/

Genre: Roguelike, Card Game, Strategy
Platform: PC

#PrimeMonster #roguelike #indiegame #pcgaming #strategygames
